name: Media Entity Datawrapper
description: Provides a media source for embedding Datawrapper visualizations.
project_description:
Provides media source support for referencing charts from Datawrapper and embedding as oEmbed content in Drupal.

 If you are a user of the Datawrapper service (either free or paid) you can embed charts, tables or maps by pasting the URL to the chart into the media entity and source this module creates for you. Voila! Embeddable charts without all the fuss.

 This avoids dealing with the iframe embeds and potential third party Javascript yourself by incorporating these as media items (similar to how YouTube or Vimeo etc embeds are handled). Once a chart is added, it can then be re-used through the Media Library for selection and is insertable into CKEditor instances that allow entity embedding just like any other media entity can.
